title: Abduction
description: While seated in the machine, spread your legs outward, squeeze your outer hip muscles, and return them in a controlled manner.

title: Adduction
description: While seated in the machine, bring your legs inward, squeeze your inner thigh muscles, and return to the starting position in a controlled manner.

title: Abs Leg Raises
description: Lie on your back, lift your legs until they are vertical, and slowly lower them using your lower abdominal muscles.

title: Crunch
description: Lie on your back with your knees bent, curl your torso up by contracting your abdominal muscles, then lower back down in a controlled manner.

title: Seated Cable Row
description: Sit with your chest upright and pull the handles toward your midsection, squeezing your shoulder blades together.

title: Lat Pulldown
description: Sit and grip the bar wide, pull it down until it's below your chin, and finish the movement by squeezing your lats.

title: Back Row
description: Sit with an upright posture, pull the bar toward your midsection by squeezing your shoulder blades, and lower it in a controlled manner.

title: Cable Shoulder Lateral Raises
description: Hold the cable to your side and, with your elbow bent, raise your arm to shoulder level.

title: Cable Crunch 1
description: Bend your knees, hold the cable behind your head, crunch your abs, and pull your torso downward.

title: Cable Crunch 2
description: Kneel, hold the cable above your head, and bend forward using your abdominal muscles.

title: Cable Overhead Extension
description: Grasp the cable overhead and extend your arms forward and upward, squeezing your triceps.

title: Cable Side Bends
description: Hold the cable with one hand steady and bend your torso to the side, tightening your obliques.

title: Calf Raises
description: Stand on your toes, lift your heels up, and lower them by contracting your calf muscles.

title: Face Pulls
description: Grip the cable at face level, pull your elbows back, and squeeze your rear deltoids.

title: Hyperextension
description: Position yourself on the hyperextension bench, keep your back straight, lift your torso upward, then lower it in a controlled manner.

title: Leg Extension
description: Sit, place the pad on your ankles, extend your knees, and squeeze your quads.

title: Leg Press
description: Place your feet on the platform, push the weight by straightening your knees from a bent position, and lower it in a controlled manner.

title: Lying Leg Curl
description: Lie face down, pull your heels toward the machine pad, and contract your hamstrings.

title: Preacher Curl
description: Place your arm on the pad, curl your wrist toward your shoulder by bending at the elbow, and squeeze your biceps.

title: Chest Butterfly
description: Sit in the machine, open your arms to the sides, squeeze your chest muscles, and return to the starting position.

title: Rear Delt Fly
description: Lean forward, open your arms out to the sides, squeeze your rear delts, and return to start.

title: Reverse Grip Triceps
description: Grip the cable with a reverse grip, keep your elbows stationary, and pull the arm downward.

title: Rotator Cuff
description: Sitting sideways or standing, keep your elbow against your body and externally rotate your forearm.

title: Seated Leg Curl
description: Sit, place the pad on your heels, bend your knees, and contract your hamstrings.

title: Smith Good Mornings
description: Position the bar on your shoulders in the Smith machine, hinge forward at the hips, then return upright.

title: Smith Squat
description: Set the bar at shoulder height on the Smith machine, squat down to work your quads and glutes.

title: Shoulder Press (Smith)
description: Seated in the Smith machine, press the bar upward from shoulder level and lower it.

title: Titled Lateral Raises
description: On an inclined bench, raise your arms out to the sides, working your deltoids.

title: Triceps Pushdown
description: Stand, push the cable handles downward with your elbows fixed, and contract your triceps.

title: Triceps Pushdown Rope
description: Hold the rope attachment with both hands, pull down with your elbows fixed, then flare your elbows and squeeze at the end.

title: Cable Biceps Curl
description: Stand, hold the cable with palms facing up, curl at the elbow, and squeeze your biceps.

title: Side Hip Abduction
description: Sitting on your side, lift your leg outward, squeeze your outer hip muscles, and lower it in a controlled manner.

title: Leg Raises 2
description: Hang from the bar and lift your legs forward, engaging your lower abs.

title: Leg Raises 3
description: Hang from the bar and bend your knees to engage your abs.

title: Twisted Hyperextension Abs
description: On the hyperextension bench, twist to one side, squeeze your obliques, and return to the starting position.
